concepts.def: Central Nervous System — brain & spinal cord

walkthroughs.body_html:
The nervous system is your body's wiring.

It carries signals at up to 120 m/s — faster than a Formula 1 car. 🏎️

CNS = brain + spinal cord.

Peripheral nerves run to every limb.

They carry messages both ways — in (sensing) and out (moving).

Touch a hot pan → your hand snaps back before you even think.

That's a reflex: a stimulus (hot) goes to the spinal cord and the response (pull away) returns — bypassing the brain. ⚡
